RU form: No validated RU respondent form verified.

Instrument (EN): Difficulties of AI Technology Integration in Teaching Scale — China teacher original study
Question count: 20 retained (24 drafted; 20 administered, zero dropped in EFA)
Scales / measured domains (EN): Four CEVB dimensions: cognitive understanding difficulties; emotional/attitudinal difficulties; volitional/motivational difficulties; behavioral/practice difficulties. Higher-order overall difficulties factor explored.
Research provenance: Qiao S, Nie Y, Niu F, He Z, Chen L. Frontiers in Psychology 2026-08-04 DOI 10.3389/fpsyg.2026.1902647. N546 primary and secondary teachers from Anhui China recruited via WeChat, randomized split EFA N273 + CFA N273 from SAME dataset (not independent cohorts); 20 items; four factors, alpha .915 omega .917; gender and school-stage invariance tested. Published items in Appendix A are not evidence of the original respondent language.
DB locales: No AITID/AI-technology-integration-difficulties stable edition in 3904 Master, PR495 original index, registered keys or 149 Supabase published keys.
EN form: English article and English appendix do NOT prove an independently validated English respondent-language form.
Other translations: Chinese teacher setting, but administered respondent language / published verbatim questionnaire version unverified; do NOT label a formally validated ZH-CN translation.
Target population: N546 K–12 classroom teachers in central/western Anhui Province China; regional convenience recruitment, no global teacher, clinical or general adult norms.
